::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Novr 9th [1885]  
**From:** Elderfield Otterbourne Winchester  
**Manuscript:** MS Princeton University, Parrish Collection
:::

Dear [Mrs Molesworth](people/person_1028.qmd) 

I am very sorry there has been such a delay in answering your letter. All those directed to the office were delaying in coming to me by a mistake

I shall be very glad to see your MS if you will still send it to me, it had better come direct here, to save time[^1]

Yours truly
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: Envelope addressed to ‘Mrs Molesworth 85 Lexham Gardens/Kensington/ W London’ postmarked No 10 85.
[^2]: Mary Louisa Molesworth, 'One Sunday Morning' *MP* 3s 11 (April 1886) 327-337.
